name: shikanime-labs/skills
description: A curated catalog of self-improved agent skills for Hermes and compatible agents: two parallel org workflows (shikanime sks-*, cloud-pi-native cpn-*) covering the full discussion, issue, and PR lifecycle, with proven-done gates, assumption validation, jj-workspace parallel fan-out, and stacked PR landing.

skills.name: sks-dev-workflow
skills.description: Use when running the shikanime local dev loop: branching, push-to-origin, jj bookmark tracking, and landing via gh stack or direct push.

skills.name: sks-async
skills.description: Use when splitting multi-unit work into parallel, isolated jj workspaces (depth-tree fan-out) and landing as independent PRs or gh stack chains.

skills.name: sks-commit
skills.description: Use when committing in shikanime-labs or shikanime-studio repos: plain-English imperative titles and repo-enforced hooks (gitlint, DCO) win.

skills.name: sks-discussion
skills.description: Use when opening an RFC Discussion in a shikanime org as the pre-issue stage: converge on the problem, then derive the issue.

skills.name: sks-issue
skills.description: Use when opening an issue in shikanime-labs or shikanime-studio: body is the problem statement, acceptance criteria as a command-decidable tasklist.

skills.name: sks-issue-refine
skills.description: Use when iterating a problem to convergence inside its GitHub issue via research and comments before deriving the PR.

skills.name: sks-issue-triage
skills.description: Use when triaging an existing shikanime org issue: assign labels, assignee, milestone, and project; close with rationale if not workable.

skills.name: sks-pr-triage
skills.description: Use when triaging an existing shikanime org PR: labels, assignee, milestone, and reviewers.

skills.name: sks-issue-workflow
skills.description: Use when you need the single entry point for the shikanime issue side: create, refine, and triage the issue before any PR.

skills.name: sks-pr-workflow
skills.description: Use when you need the single entry point for the shikanime PR side: ensure the issue exists, open, triage, and land the PR.

skills.name: sks-discussion-triage
skills.description: Use when triaging an existing shikanime org discussion: category, body shape, Q&A answer, and conversion to an issue.

skills.name: sks-pr
skills.description: Use when opening a PR in shikanime-labs or shikanime-studio: push to origin, --head org:branch, plain-English title, issue linkage, parity with commit.

skills.name: sks-land
skills.description: Use when landing a shikanime org PR after reconciliation (sks-pr-resolve) and review approval gates pass; closes the linked issue deliberately.

skills.name: sks-pr-resolve
skills.description: Use when resolving a shikanime PR's review conversations, checking the DoD ledger, and reconciling before merge (no merge itself).

skills.name: sks-pr-review
skills.description: Use when reviewing shikanime code: enforce YAGNI, root-cause fixes, and project conventions before approval.

skills.name: sks-doc
skills.description: Use when documenting a shikanime project in the repo's docs/ directory after a behavior-changing PR.

skills.name: cpn-dev-workflow
skills.description: À utiliser quand vous travaillez dans le dépôt console cloud-pi-native/console : règles de contribution, cycle de dev et workflow PR.

skills.name: cpn-commit
skills.description: Commit to cloud-pi-native/console with conventional format.

skills.name: cpn-discussion
skills.description: Create/edit console Discussions (French, GraphQL).

skills.name: cpn-issue
skills.description: Open CPN console issues with French templates.

skills.name: cpn-pr
skills.description: Open cloud-pi-native org PRs with French body and conventional title.

skills.name: cpn-pr-review
skills.description: Review cloud-pi-native console PRs: arch, French.

skills.name: cpn-issue-triage
skills.description: Triage une issue existante du dépôt cloud-pi-native/console : labels, assignee, jalon, projet ; fermeture motivée si non traitable.

skills.name: cpn-pr-triage
skills.description: Triage une PR existante du dépôt cloud-pi-native/console : labels, assignee, jalon, reviewers, lien issue.

skills.name: cpn-discussion-triage
skills.description: Triage une discussion cloud-pi-native/console : catégorie, corps, Q&A, clôture (GraphQL).

skills.name: cpn-async
skills.description: À utiliser quand vous répartissez un travail multi-unités en parallèle sur workspaces jj isolés et PR en stack pour console cloud-pi-native.

skills.name: cpn-issue-refine
skills.description: Itérer un problème vers la convergence dans son issue GitHub via recherche + commentaires (console cloud-pi-native).

skills.name: cpn-issue-workflow
skills.description: À utiliser quand vous voulez le point d'entrée unique du côté issue cloud-pi-native : créer l'issue, la raffiner vers la convergence, puis la trier.

skills.name: cpn-pr-workflow
skills.description: À utiliser quand vous voulez le point d'entrée unique du côté PR cloud-pi-native : assure l'issue, ouvre la PR draft dérivée du commit, puis trie.

skills.name: cpn-pr-resolve
skills.description: Réconcilie review-threads d'une PR cloud-pi-native : ledger DoD + approbation/CI, SANS merger (extrait cpn-dev-workflow).
